name: vacuum_freeze_min_age
description: Minimum transaction age (in XID count) at which VACUUM freezes a row version to prevent transaction ID wraparound.
symptoms: Query failures from frozen XID exhaustion
tuning_tips: Set lower than autovacuum_freeze_max_age (typically half or less) to proactively freeze rows before wraparound danger; avoid setting too low to prevent excessive freezing overhead during routine VACUUM.
